bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches are allowed. Non-clear bags receive extra screening. Backpacks are prohibited.
prohibited: Bags larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Use Adams Street Garage at 4th Avenue. It opens at 6 p.m. weekdays and earlier on weekends. It is unavailable for weekday shows before 6 p.m. Pay cashlessly.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Arizona Financial Theatre's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Pay by card or mobile wallet. Cash-to-card conversion is available at the upgrade podium.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Arizona Financial Theatre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Collect will call at 4th Avenue and Washington Street. Bring matching photo ID and your confirmation number.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors usually open one hour before showtime. Check your ticket for the specific time. Overnight camping is prohibited.
